positive_cases.operation: whole connected block rotate 90 about own off-anchor pivot plus [1.27,2.54]
whole connected block rotate 180 about own pivot
whole connected block rotate 270 about own pivot plus [-2.54,1.27]
one unit only including its NCs, rotate 90 preserving existing mirror; protect other same-ref unit
different rotated/mirrored single unit translate then fresh process query; second local rotate/edit/save/query
shared child connected block rotate 270 with complete 2-instance acknowledgment; source changed once, all occurrences equivalent

negative_cases.case: one attached wire moved without rest of connected block
attached NC marker selected without pin
isolated protected block translated into a new existing wire contact
two transforms overlap one source object
one valid transform plus one invalid angle in batch

oracles: Freeze all source UUIDs, fields, logical instances, every library pin ordinal, physical pin number, unit, local/world coordinate and NC attachment
Independently compare numeric transformed points using exact Decimal integer nm and CCW screen rotation (x,y)->(y,-x)
Preserve unrelated tokens and selected object identity/style; selected field positions move with owner, visible angles normalize 0/90
Compare independent raw occurrence component partitions, explicit names and NC attachments before/after
Official XML compares physical (reference,pin) connected groups and qualified local/global names, with XML physical-pin dedup disclosed
Official ERC findings normalize identity/rule/severity excluding transformed coordinate text; no new findings or ignores
Official all-page SVG rendered with frozen renderer; actual full images reviewed before confirm and after saved reopening
Every rejected attempt must leave all engineering source bytes unchanged from its own immediate baseline
stop_rule: First functional failure retained with exact inputs/outputs; true native exception, timeout or incomplete process-tree observation stops that execution cycle; do not rerun for green
report: Source-only checks, Native consumer calls, actual EXE public calls, positive saves, zero-write negatives and actual candidate/saved image views counted separately
